description: The Centro de Dados of Portugal's Directorate-General for Territory (DGT) is the download platform for the national mapping agency's geographic datasets. The catalogue page read on 2026-09-28 offers collections of LiDAR-derived digital elevation models, orthophotos, and LiDAR elevation data for the Autonomous Region of the Azores, the latter including digital terrain models, digital surface models and point clouds from airborne LiDAR, together with a map, a LiDAR visualiser and a downloads area for registered users. Coverage is mainland Portugal and the Azores for the collections named. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): CC-BY-4.0 (DGT: data downloaded from the Centro de Dados are under CC BY 4.0). Access is free of charge. Caveats: collection dates, resolutions and tiling were not opened in the catalogue, and Madeira is not named. It supports terrain and surface models for flood, coastal and landslide exposure studies and city digital twins in Portugal. Related record: data-renep-portugal-gnss-network is the DGT geodetic network that complements the elevation data.
